faq.title: Your Brow App Questions, Answered
faq.description: How to analyze your eyebrow shape and try a new brow filter with Browlens.

items.question: What is Browlens?
items.answer: Browlens is the brow app for exploring your eyebrow shape with AI. Upload a photo, review your brow mapping, and choose a style to preview.

items.question: Can I analyze my brows for free without signing up?
items.answer: Yes. You can upload a photo and use the brow mapping and shape analysis tools without an account. Generating a new try-on image requires sign-in and credits; the tool shows the credit cost before you generate.

items.question: What photo should I upload?
items.answer: Use a clear, front-facing photo with even lighting and both eyebrows visible. Choose a JPG, PNG, or WebP file up to 15 MB.

items.question: How do eyebrow filters work?
items.answer: Choose a brow style, check the brow mapping on your photo, then generate a preview to compare the look on your face.

items.question: Can I compare different eyebrow shapes?
items.answer: Yes. Try an eyebrow filter on your photo, compare the before and after, then explore another shape to find a look you like.

items.question: Will a preview match my final look exactly?
items.answer: A preview is a visual reference. Photo quality, your natural brows, and styling technique can affect the final result.
